passage: The Riverdale Community Summer Festival is back, and it's going to be more lively than ever! On Saturday, 15th July, from 10 am to 6 pm, join us at the Riverside Park for a day full of excitement. The highlight of the festival is the annual sailing contest, where participants can show off their skills on the lake. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced sailor, everyone is welcome to enter. Besides the contest, there will be numerous stalls offering delicious food, including a variety of frozen treats to keep you cool. For those who prefer land-based fun, we have hand-held game consoles set up for friendly competitions. Live music performances will add to the lively atmosphere, making it a perfect day out for families and friends. Registration for the sailing contest is free, but due to limited spaces, it's advisable to sign up early. You can register online or at the information booth on the day. Remember, it's unlikely that we'll have another event like this until next summer, so don't miss this opportunity!

options.D: To describe food at a festival.

options.A: To encourage people to register early.
options.B: To suggest that the contest is difficult.
options.C: To explain why the festival is expensive.
options.D: To indicate that only experienced sailors can join.
